ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image is a partial schematic diagram of the solar system. The left side is marked “Earth,” beside Earth there is “Moon,” the right side is marked “Jupiter,” and near the middle there is a planet marked “M,” indicating that M is a planet in the partial solar system shown in the diagram. The question stem asks one to judge whether organisms may exist on planet M, and to fill in “one must understand whether the ______ on planet M is suitable.” According to the basic conditions for the survival of organisms, besides water and an atmosphere suitable for breathing, environmental conditions suitable for life activities are also needed; “whether it is suitable” usually corresponds to whether the temperature on the planet is suitable. raw_record.question_text:
Read the partial schematic diagram of the solar system at a certain moment.

<image1>

If one wants to judge whether organisms may exist on planet M, one must understand whether the ______ on planet M is suitable.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像，确认M是太阳系局部示意图中的一颗星球。再读题干：问题要求填入“必须了解M星球上的______是否适宜”。根据生物生存条件，判断某星球能否有生物，需要看环境温度是否适合生命活动。因此空格填“温度”。
method.CoT_raw: 图像中是太阳系局部示意图，左侧标有“地球”，地球旁有“月球”，右侧标有“木星”，中间附近有一颗标为“M”的星球，说明M是图中太阳系局部的一颗星球。题干要求判断M星球上是否可能有生物存在，并填入“必须了解M星球上的______是否适宜”。根据生物生存的基本条件，除了水和适合呼吸的大气外，还需要环境条件适合生命活动；“是否适宜”通常对应星球上的温度是否适宜。因此空格应填“温度”。

planner_metadata.image_role: 先观察图像：示意图中标有“地球”“月球”“木星”和“M”，M画成一个独立小圆点，位于地球/月球与木星之间的太阳系局部轨道示意中，说明题目讨论的是M星球的生存环境。
